details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It registers a postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and its main module (`index.js`) also invokes the same beacon on require, then exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions so an importing application does not crash. The beacon POSTs a JSON body to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with the header `x-beacon-package: @c1-ease/autoloan` (TLS verification disabled via rejectUnauthorized:false, 5s timeout, failures silently swallowed). The body contains only install metadata: package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the npm user-agent string. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted. This is a security-research artifact that self-declares in its README as an authorized dependency-confusion test; the README credits researcher Kero (@0xWise) / an account. Behaviour is limited to an install-time callback to the researcher's own host.
